title: Phone and Internet Networks Go Dark Across Tigray
detail: Telecom and internet connectivity across Tigray stopped on Friday, Sep 25, 2026, with the TPLF reportedly directing Ethio Telecom and Safaricom to cut phone and internet access in areas under its control. NetBlocks, an independent internet-monitoring organization, detected an internet disruption in northern Ethiopia consistent with reports of the blackout. The shutdown compounds fears of a blockade as fighting continues on multiple fronts and residents in unaffected areas rush to stock supplies and withdraw cash.

title: Human Rights Watch Calls August Mekelle Drone Strike 'Unlawfully Indiscriminate'
detail: Human Rights Watch published a report on Sep 25, 2026 concluding that the Aug 20, 2026 airstrike on a residential compound in Mekelle's Daero neighborhood — part of the dual strikes that wounded 13 civilians including 7 children — used an air-dropped general-purpose bomb that left a roughly 4-meter crater and struck a compound 'with no evident military targets.' HRW characterized the strike as unlawfully indiscriminate under international humanitarian law and called on Ethiopian authorities to 'impartially and transparently investigate the attack, prosecute those responsible for any wrongdoing, and adequately compensate the victims.' The group also urged the African Union to convene parties under the November 2022 Pretoria agreement framework.
confidenceReason: The physical findings (crater size, bomb type, lack of military target) are HRW's own field assessment; the Ethiopian government has not responded to the report.
